paragraphs: TeamLinkt sells sports registration, scheduling, and administration software to the organizations that run seasons. Registration forms are built inside the platform and payments are collected online, and schedules are published from the same place. An app puts schedules, scores, standings, and updates in front of athletes and their families, with team chat in place of scattered texts and email chains.

League operators get tools for building balanced schedules, tracking standings, assigning officials, and running game day operations across divisions. Clubs and associations get registration templates, rostering, scheduling across fields, courts, and ice times, and tracking of waivers, background checks, and certifications. Governing bodies register and manage their member clubs and associations, track compliance across them, and can run their own competitions.

Core features are free, with a paid bundle for organizations that want more advanced tools. An account is offered with no contract and no credit card. Support is offered over live chat rather than a ticket based queue.

quote.text: TeamLinkt brings every piece of your season into one platform, helping you deliver fair, on-time games with less manual work and fewer tools to juggle.
